mechanic.summary: Ziekket summons Lightspawn Lashers and reawakens any dormant lashers with increased power and control immunity.
mechanic.response: Group and kill lashers quickly, then use Concentrated Lightbeam to remove their dormant corpses before the next awakening.

provenance.description: Compact tactical classification from Wowhead's Patch 12.1 Blinding Vale guide and linked spell record.
